comments.text: Fetching only ids and re-loading each referencing record right before modifying/deleting it (skipping ones already removed by a nested cascade via sql.ErrNoRows) addresses the root cause: no stale in-memory record can overwrite changes made by nested cascades. The re-query loop still terminates because processed records either get deleted or lose the reference. The added self-referencing test covers the reported scenario. Minor: this adds one query per referenced record, which is acceptable inside the transaction but worth noting for very large cascades.
